landing.heroSub: AI-powered crop, soil, weather and market intelligence designed for Indian farmers.
landing.problemDesc: Farmers struggle with scattered data across weather apps, local mandi physical visits, unverified pest advice, and uncertain crop choices.
landing.solutionDesc: We combine field location, soil pH, satellite weather, disease image recognition, and live market trends into simple actionable advice.
